summary: Frontend-only testing of 'Mal di Testa Tracker' Expo web preview (no backend). All 12 requested flows verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Nuovo screen loads directly, intensity pills 0-5 update the big number, all 6 factor chips toggle, Salva persists with 'Episodio salvato' toast and resets form, Annulla resets with 'Annullato, niente salvato' toast, Storico shows episodes reverse-chronologically, delete flow (inline confirm + cancel-delete + confirm-delete) works, 'Episodio eliminato' toast fires, persistence across page reload confirmed via AsyncStorage web fallback, empty state 'Nessun mal di testa registrato.' shown when no episodes, CSV export triggers browser download with filename mal_di_testa_YYYY-MM-DD.csv and 'CSV scaricato' toast, empty-list export shows 'Nessun episodio da esportare' error toast, back-button returns to Nuovo. No console errors or page errors observed.

issues: Empty-state image (Pexels landscape of a lake) is thematically unrelated to 'no headaches'. Not broken but feels arbitrary; consider a more relevant illustration or a plain icon.

action_items: (Optional/polish) Consider replacing the Pexels lake image in the Storico empty state with a more relevant asset (e.g. celebratory icon or headache-free illustration).
(Optional) `expo-file-system/legacy` is used explicitly in src/csv.ts — works today but the non-legacy API is the long-term path; not urgent.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean separation: on-device SQLite for native and AsyncStorage-based fallback for web is correctly gated by Platform.OS.
All interactive elements have proper testID attributes; text is always wrapped in <Text>; styles via StyleSheet.create.
MongoDB / backend concerns not applicable (no backend used).
BackHandler.exitApp() is correctly Android-only and does nothing on web preview — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Three test episodes were created during automated run; all were deleted at the end so app is left in empty state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL: https://episode-logger-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. Web preview uses AsyncStorage fallback (key episodi_v1). To reset app state during tests: page.evaluate("() => localStorage.clear()") then reload. All flows exercised in one playwright script; no flakes observed.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA — all requested features pass.
